component.name: FastHello
component.summary: Starter kit and widget sandbox for light, fast Linux apps

description.p: FastHello is the starting point of the Fast apps: small Linux desktop apps written in Rust with Slint that start quickly and use little memory. It is also a working app, with a greeting page and a Widgets page where you can try every control of the shared kit.
The Widgets page has five tabs:

ul.li: Inputs: checkbox, slider, spin box, switch, radio buttons and text fields, linked to each other.
Table: sort, search and filter rows.
Feedback: progress bar, spinner and status messages.
Buttons: text, icon and delete-with-confirmation buttons.

description.p: It follows the system accent colour and light or dark mode, can be switched between English and Portuguese, and remembers its window size.

screenshot.caption: The Table tab: search, filters and sortable columns
The Buttons tab in the dark theme

description.p: Release 0.1.7: update Slint to 1.19 and raise the MSRV to 1.95.
Slint and slint-build go from 1.18 to 1.19, and Cargo.lock is refreshed.
rust-version and the MSRV CI job move from 1.92 to 1.95. AGENTS.md, README.md and RELEASING.md are updated to match.
The Flatpak source now skips .git and docs/screenshots, so the build copies less.
The workspace version goes to 0.1.7 and the metainfo release date to 2026-11-19.
New Buttons tab on the Widgets page, and the kit's progress bar replaces Fluent's.
Selected rows use a neutral tint, tabs can show a count, icon buttons show a tooltip, and small grey text is easier to read on dark.
The window size is not saved while maximized, and a second start can no longer be held up by a slow client.
